policy: Every item must be eliminated; entries are a remediation catalog, not an allowlist.

families.strategy: Move theme reads into resolver boundaries and add concrete runtime values to resolved specs. Render/layout/motion helpers consume resolved values only.
subtasks: Delete legacy Theme overloads when resolved-spec overloads already exist.
List item rendering uses ListItemSpec fonts/opacities only.
Card/Snackbar specs gain concrete radius/elevation/motion runtime fields.
Surface render helper accepts only concrete resolved frame values/spec fields.
Autocomplete/Tabs keep ThemeContext plumbing but delegate Theme->Spec conversion to an allowed resolution boundary.
FAB variants resolve through the dedicated action/FAB resolver; no Theme reads in the widget body.

families.strategy: Component catalog/docs/gallery metadata belongs in Tooling, never Core. If the implementation has already moved, remove stale baseline entries rather than recreating Core ownership.
Physical ThemeModel/ThemeIO/ThemeRuntime targets from Spec 006 must exist and be required by the architecture config.
Spec 008/010 must leave zero textual-key violations; do not re-baseline any residual alias/string lookup.
